source: Storyline templates (see the GDD, 'Incidents, rivalries and storylines'). A storyline is a short arc of beats. 'trigger' says what starts it, each beat in 'beats' has a 'when' (start: as soon as the storyline starts, meeting: once both drivers race the same final, next_round: the round after the last beat), and 'cards' holds the choices an event card offers at a beat. A choice's 'effects' are 'fans' (a share of the series audience, gained by the driver), 'reputation' (points, 0 to 100 for the driver) and 'relationship' (points between the two drivers, -100 to 100). At most 'highlightCap' storylines are highlighted for the player at a time; an unanswered card expires when the next round is run.
